GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well sat 1 length off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off , found little, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bounded on jumping. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well. Pushed fwd & worked to share lead Two Wide early . Stayed =lead Two Wide midrace & pushed along =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Weakened Four Wide in straight. # On-pace/weakened.
Jumped Ok drifted back 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no run on

jumped awkwardly . Rolled fwd & led narrowly on inside early . Held lead on rail until joined in front midrace. Pushed to quicken =lead on inside on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & boxed untli weakened in last 100m. Vetted clear. # On-pace/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Went Forward and burst Clear to Lead x 4L @ 800m. same to straightening up . Collared 200m, Couldn'T Go On # led x 4L/wilted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped heavily with another runner at the start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Went Forward 2nd on rail 1 length @ 700m. Joined Lead home Turn . peaked 300m, Gradually Gave Ground # couldn't finish off
Jumped Ok sat rail half off, took over turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, still 1 length clear 200m, headed passing 100m and faded # led/headed 100m
Jumped Fast and led clearly (3 Lengths ) 800m, came back to them before the corner, headed last 200m and faded out of placings, Blinkers First Time # led/weakened
Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, joined turn, headed Straightening Up and kept on one pace # led/headed turn

Began OK. Rolled fwd & led keenly on inside by 1 length early . Held 1/2L lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 200m & weakened in & laid in over last 150m. # Led & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was hampered by another runner, which shifted in abruptly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead half clear, ridden along turn, headed narrowly Straightening Up , half off passing 200m and battled on strong one pace to the line # led/sound

jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide With Cover (3L from lead). Worked to hold ground until pushed along Four Wide @ 500m. Struggling & laid out Five Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Six Wide in straight. Vetted clar. # Wide but poor.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began very awkwardly. Hung out rounding the home turn. A post race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
